"import requests
import json
import re
import pathlib

ROOT = pathlib.Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
SCRATCH = ROOT / 'scratch'
STATE_FILE = SCRATCH / 'wyvern_platform_state.json'

with open(STATE_FILE, 'r', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    state = json.load(f)

bundles = state.get('script_bundles', [])
headers = {
    'User-Agent': 'Mozilla/5.0 (Windows NT 10.0; Win64; x64) AppleWebKit/537.36 (KHTML, like Gecko) Chrome/120.0.0.0 Safari/537.36'
}

keywords = [
    'changelog', 'release', 'update', 'announcement', 'whats-new', 'feature',
    'model', 'openrouter', 'anthropic', 'openai', 'gemini', 'deepseek', 'glm',
    'scenario', 'lorebook', 'world', 'persona', 'inventory', 'marketplace',
    'tts', 'voice', 'audio', 'image'
]

print(f"Total bundles to inspect: {len(bundles)}")
findings = []

for b in bundles:
    url = f"https://app.wyvern.chat{b}"
    try:
        r = requests.get(url, headers=headers, timeout=10)
        if r.status_code != 200:
            continue
        text = r.text
        # Check for changelog or release notes modal
        cl_matches = re.findall(r'("[\w\s\.\-]{5,100}(?:changelog|release|v\d\.\d|patch notes)[\w\s\.\-]*)', text, re.IGNORECASE)
        if cl_matches:
            findings.append((b, "Changelog string", cl_matches[:3]))
        
        # Check for new routes or endpoints
        endpoints = re.findall(r'["\'](/api/[\w/\-_]+)["\']', text)
        if endpoints:
            findings.append((b, "Endpoints", set(endpoints)))
